sounds.about: Lo-fi hip-hop: felted keys, lazy swung drums, upright bass, vinyl crackle, everything lowpassed.
Swing trio + horn: ride in triplets, walking upright bass, sparse piano comping, muted trumpet.

sounds.about: Bossa nova: nylon guitar comping, bossa clave on the rim, soft kick, shaker, flute melody.
12-bar style shuffle: boogie guitar figure, walking bass, harmonica lead, shuffled drums.
Slow soul: Wurlitzer chords, round electric bass, sax melody, finger snaps, a pad of strings.
Funk: slap bass on the one, clavinet 16ths, muted guitar scratch, brass stabs, tight drums with ghost notes.
Disco: four-on-the-floor, open hat on every off-beat, octave bass, string machine, clav chick.
Roots reggae: one-drop drums (kick and rim on beat 3), organ and guitar skank on the off-beats, melodic bass with space.
Salsa: 2-3 son clave, conga tumbao, piano montuno, anticipated bass, cowbell, trumpet line.
Reggaeton: the dembow (kick on every beat, snare on the 'a' of 1 and the 'and' of 2), sub bass, plucked hook.
Rock: overdriven power chords (clean guitar + distortion on the layer), eighth-note bass, big backbeat, lead guitar.
Metal: palm-muted gallops with heavy distortion, double kick, half-time snare, low power chords.
Modern pop: piano chords, round bass, simple beat with claps, a soft lead hook and a plucked counter-line.
Synthwave: pulsing eighth-note bass, string machine chords, plucked arpeggio, gated-reverb snare, soaring lead.
House: four-on-the-floor, off-beat open hat, claps, rubbery FM bass on the off-beats, piano chord stabs.
Acid techno: a 16th-note 303 line whose accents open the filter, relentless kick, off-beat hats, rim.
Drum and bass: two-step breakbeat with ghost snares, long reese bass notes, a cold pad and bell stabs.
Trap: half-time clap on beat 3, long sliding 808 bass, hi-hat 16ths with fast rolls, a dark sparse bell.
8-bit chiptune: pulse lead, fast arpeggio standing in for chords, triangle bass, noise drums.
Heroic orchestral: horn theme over string chords, trumpet answer, cello and timpani underneath, taiko and cymbal accents.
Baroque: harpsichord broken chords, a walking cello bass line and an oboe melody with ornaments; no drums.
Ragtime piano: left hand strides (bass note, chord), right hand plays a syncopated tune. One instrument.
Music-box lullaby in 3/4: music box melody, celesta broken chords, a soft glass pad; no drums.
Spooky: theremin tune over diminished pipe-organ chords, a celesta ostinato, a tolling bell and low timpani.
Christmas: sleigh bells on every eighth, glockenspiel tune, warm strings and horns, chimes on the downbeats.
Celtic jig in 6/8: fiddle tune doubled by a whistle, harp chords, bodhran pulse (each beat here is a dotted quarter).
Bluegrass: banjo roll, boom-chick guitar and mandolin chop, upright bass on one and three, fiddle on top.
Oompah / polka: tuba on the beat, accordion chords on the off-beat, clarinet tune, snare and cymbal.
Tango: staccato accordion (bandoneon) and piano marking four, upright bass, a dramatic violin line in a minor key.
Andean folk: pan flute melody, tremolo-picked charango (mandolin), nylon guitar, a deep bombo drum.
Middle-Eastern: Hijaz-scale oboe (zurna) line with ornaments, plucked oud-style riff, dum-tek hand drum, string drone.
Indian classical flavour: sitar phrases in raga Yaman over a drone, tabla keeping a 16-beat cycle.
Japanese: koto arpeggios in the In scale (D Eb G A Bb), a breathy bamboo flute, sparse taiko.
Gamelan: interlocking metallophone patterns on a five-note scale, a slower core melody, a gong marking the cycle.
Ambient: slow warm pad and glass pad, sparse handpan notes, a singing bowl, long reverb; no pulse.
